QuestInfo.name: Wounded Victory
QuestInfo.0: Go see #b#p3001102##k, who is now the temporary captain of the HQ at #b#m401040000##k to hear about future plans.
QuestInfo.1: Disguised as a Specter, infiltrate the castle and try to use #b#t2430963##k.
QuestInfo.2: You succeeded in infiltrating the castle. Now what?

0.0: All of these long battles are draining our men. There's just not enough time to rest.
0.1: I believe we have to use the momentum we have to charge the castle. Would you be willing to infiltrate the castle beforehand to soften the place up for our troops?
0.2: You probably know more about Specters than any other warrior in Grandis. Now's the time for you to become one. Put on this Specter disguise and do your best to blend in...
0.3: Just so you know, #b#p3001002##k made this thing. I know that's sort of an odd job for him, but I think he did pretty well. Especially for an ancient old coot...\r\n#r#e(If you accept, you will automatically move to the relevant field.)\r\n

yes.0: Put this on and try to get inside that closed castle gate. We can communicate through the #bD-02 Receiver#k I stuck in there. Turn that device on once you enter the castle.#b(Is a silly costume going to work? Oh well, I'll just destroy anybody who messes with me.)#k
yes.1: We got that #bD-02 Receiver#k from the Grandis Shadow just for this mission. Don't... don't break it, okay? I don't think I can afford another.

no.0: Sorry to spring this one on you, but #b#p3001002##k made this disguise so that it only fits you. Nobody else can do it...

1.0: All right, I'm in. Better turn on that receiver and let HQ know.
